excluded_sessions.session_20260904_173735: User confirmed: cameras were accidentally moved before the September 5 recapture. Backup only; exclude from fitting, evaluation, and comparison.

session_policy: Fit and evaluate each session independently. No cross-session rig identity is assumed.
selection_policy: Use common events for both session cameras. Require stored capture gate and PnP success, at least max(4, capture-time minimum corners), stored reprojection within capture-time maximum, finite proper transforms, positive board depth, valid RGB and matching intrinsic serial/resolution. Conservatively exclude events with any foreign marker IDs. Never filter using a calibration method's output or held-out residual.

split.note: Group near-duplicate robot poses before splitting. Hold out group indices 3, 7, ... in event order. No image residual or solver result is used to select the split.
